headline: Proposals to eliminate duplicate procedures when crossing borders made at OTG
summary: Member states of the Organization of Turkic States are discussing the removal of duplicate border-crossing procedures. They are also considering a single-entry principle to simplify crossings.
why: The Organization of Turkic States is an intergovernmental body, and simpler border procedures could reduce trade and transport costs across member countries.
original_headline: Отменить дублирующие процедуры при пересечении границ предлагают в ОТГ
